name: audit-logging-monitoring
description: Audits security logging and alerting controls for missing audit events, weak monitoring, sensitive data in logs, log injection, insufficient retention, tamper-prone logs, and missing detection for authentication, authorization, administrative, and data access events.
instructions:
# audit-logging-monitoring

Audits whether security-relevant events are recorded, protected, monitored, and actionable.

## Orchestration

1. Load `references/rules.yaml` to get the active `ALM-` rule set.
2. Load `../_shared/owasp-cheatsheets.yaml` and use the mapped OWASP cheat sheets to support remediation guidance and references.
3. Identify target evidence from source code, configuration, tests, API specs, IaC, CI/CD, runtime manifests, and documentation relevant to the request.
4. Evaluate each rule using its `match_strategy`, preserving file path, line, snippet, control context, and confidence.
5. Mark each rule `Pass`, `Fail`, `Partial`, `Unknown`, or `Not Applicable` based on available evidence.
6. Prioritize findings by severity, exploitability, exposed surface, and whether a concrete remediation is available.
7. Render the final report using `references/report-template.md`.

## Usage

Scan the current repository:

```text
/audit-logging-monitoring
```

Scan a specific path:

```text
/audit-logging-monitoring src/ services/ docs/
```

## OWASP Cheat Sheets

Use the shared mapping in `../_shared/owasp-cheatsheets.yaml` for authoritative OWASP Cheat Sheet Series references that match this skill. Include the relevant cheat sheet links in the report when they directly support a finding or remediation.

## Review Guidance

Prioritize authentication, authorization, admin, secret, data access, payment, and release events that lack logs or alerts.

rules.name: Log authentication success and failure
rules.description: Identify login, MFA, reset, and token events without security logs.
rules.remediation: Log authentication events with subject, result, source, timestamp, and correlation ID.

rules.name: Log access control denials and privilege changes
rules.description: Identify missing logs for denied access, role changes, permission changes, and tenant-boundary failures.
rules.remediation: Log authorization decisions and privilege mutations with actor and target.

rules.name: Log administrative actions
rules.description: Identify admin operations without audit trails.
rules.remediation: Log admin changes, settings changes, user management, and policy updates.

rules.name: Log sensitive data access safely
rules.description: Identify sensitive data access without audit trail or with raw sensitive values in logs.
rules.remediation: Log metadata for sensitive access and redact protected values.

rules.name: Alert on high-risk security events
rules.description: Identify critical events without alerting or escalation.
rules.remediation: Create alerts for suspicious auth, privilege changes, secret access, and integrity failures.

rules.name: Detect log injection risks
rules.description: Identify untrusted input logged without encoding, escaping, or structured logging.
rules.remediation: Use structured logging and encode untrusted values.

rules.name: Protect logs from tampering
rules.description: Identify logs stored where attackers or app users can alter them.
rules.remediation: Send logs to append-only or centralized systems with restricted access.

rules.name: Validate log retention
rules.description: Identify missing retention policy for audit and security logs.
rules.remediation: Set retention based on incident response and compliance needs.

rules.name: Require request and trace correlation IDs
rules.description: Identify security logs without request, session, user, or trace correlation.
rules.remediation: Add correlation identifiers to security-relevant logs.

rules.name: Monitor exceptional security conditions
rules.description: Identify auth, validation, deserialization, crypto, or access exceptions without monitoring.
rules.remediation: Alert on repeated or unusual security-relevant exceptions.

rules.name: Detect sensitive data leakage in logs
rules.description: Identify credentials, tokens, PII, payment, or health data logged in cleartext.
rules.remediation: Redact, tokenize, or avoid logging sensitive values.

rules.name: Require response runbooks for critical alerts
rules.description: Identify critical alerts without owner or response guidance.
rules.remediation: Define alert owners, severity, escalation path, and investigation runbook.
